businessTypes.question: What types of businesses does Ozony Tech work with?
businessTypes.answer: Ozony Tech is built for small businesses that need practical help with networking, Wi-Fi, firewall setup, troubleshooting, and day-to-day IT support. That can include offices, retail spaces, barbershops, salons, restaurants, creative studios, and other local teams that need dependable technology.

existingNetworks.question: Do you help with existing networks, or only brand-new setups?
existingNetworks.answer: Both. Ozony Tech can troubleshoot and improve existing setups or help plan cleaner new installations. The goal is to understand what is already in place, identify the real issue, and recommend practical next steps instead of overcomplicating the solution.

wifiImprovements.question: Can you improve slow or unreliable Wi-Fi without replacing everything?
wifiImprovements.answer: In many cases, yes. Weak coverage, device congestion, poor placement, outdated settings, or bad segmentation can all create Wi-Fi problems. Ozony Tech focuses on finding the root cause first and then recommending the most sensible fix based on the business and the current setup.

supportTypes.question: Do you offer remote support, onsite support, or both?
supportTypes.answer: That depends on the type of issue. Some problems can be handled remotely, while others make more sense onsite. Ozony Tech focuses on the support approach that best fits the problem, the environment, and the business need.

serviceAreas.question: What areas does Ozony Tech serve?
serviceAreas.answer: Ozony Tech currently focuses on businesses in NYC, New Jersey, Connecticut, and Pennsylvania, with service pages built around those areas. If you are nearby and not sure whether your location is a fit, reaching out is the best next step.

getQuote.question: How do I get a quote or start the conversation?
getQuote.answer: Use the <contactLink>contact form</contactLink> on the site and share a little about your business, location, and what kind of help you need. A short description of the issue or goal makes it easier to recommend the right next step, whether that is troubleshooting, cleanup, an upgrade, or a new setup.
